About Koddi
We are a global technology company with software and services that help top digital marketplaces effectively monetize their first-party audiences through industry-leading commerce media technology and strategy. Our enterprise platforms leverage first-party data to drive marketplace revenue and profit by improving user experience and target shoppers throughout the purchase path. Koddi’s platforms enable any advertiser, any marketplace, in any industry to increase awareness, generate demand, and drive revenue. We are committed to driving innovation and growth in the commerce media space.
 
As part of that commitment, we’ve launched Koddi Academy, a learning platform designed to provide expert knowledge, competitive insights, and practical strategies for thriving in this fast-growing industry. Explore our latest certification course, to deepen your expertise and stay ahead in the evolving world of commerce media.

You can also sign up for our waiting list to be notified when new courses are released. Get started today at Koddi Academy.

Associate Software Engineer Cohort - Start date February 15th, 2027.

Koddi is excited to announce our Engineering training program geared towards recent graduates with Statistics or Computer Science degrees as well as recent grads who have completed coding bootcamps! The Koddi Impact Program is an intensive 8-week training program that includes all aspects of Engineering at Koddi. In addition to technical training during this program, and on an ongoing basis, we will also provide instructor-led and self-paced leadership development opportunities.

Program Highlights:

Work with industry-leading experts to gain hands-on knowledge and experience
Gain a comprehensive understanding of the Koddi business
Have the opportunity to share and present ideas with team members
Participate in leadership workshops and soft skill development
Receive executive mentorship and peer-to-peer support throughout the program

Please check out our KIP landing page for more information on the program. 

What You'll Do:

Collaborate with a team of software engineers, contributing to an agile environment
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, identify gaps and document business processes
Write clean, organized, and maintainable code 
Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to develop, debug, and test software, while taking ownership of the quality, correctness, and security of the code you deliver.
Assist in developing tools and libraries to support automation efforts
Support product features through various stages of development and deployment
Learn and apply software best practices while incorporating new technologies
Work with the product management and program teams to help define feature specifications and contribute to product development
Participate in analyzing and improving system efficiency and scalability
Ensure that business requirements are met by assisting in the creation and execution of automated tests
Contribute to technical discussions and actively participate in team problem-solving sessions

What You'll Bring:

Graduating with a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or successful completion of relevant bootcamp coursework
Graduation/Bootcamp completion date no later than December 2026
Demonstrated software engineering experience from previous internship, work experience, coding competitions, or publications
Experience with web application development, distributed and parallel systems, developing large software systems, or security software development
Demonstrate proficiency in data analysis, programming and software engineering
Ability to produce high quality code with good test coverage, using modern abstractions and frameworks
Ability to grasp non-technical business concepts and translate them into working products
Experience in computer science, with competencies in data structures, algorithms and software design
Experience programming in two or more of the following languages: C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Go, Python, Typescript or similar
Work independently, use available resources to get unblocked, and complete tasks on-schedule by exercising strong judgment and problem solving skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills and eagerness to learn 
Enjoys working in a fast paced environment with high collaboration
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Availability to be onsite for the duration of the program Monday-Friday in our Fort Worth office

If you believe you belong to any of the categories of protected veterans listed below, please indicate by making the appropriate selection. As a government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), we request this information in order to measure the effectiveness of the outreach and positive recruitment efforts we undertake pursuant to VEVRAA. Classification of protected categories is as follows:

A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.

A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.

An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.

An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.
